reason: Boots magnesium is about £5 and I'd only be guessing whether these gummies work any better. £24.99 for one jar of sweets with sugar and glucose syrup in them is a lot to pay on a hunch, even with a refund promise.
objection: I can't tell if 180mg in a gummy does anything I'd notice, and it's a brand I've never heard of with no reviews or proof beyond the wording on the label.
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews or a friend I trust saying they've felt a real difference, plus a price nearer the Boots one.
